thread:
Alex: Hey team, opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/492 — schema + backfill for user_profiles.email_verified. Plan: add nullable column, index concurrently, backfill via batched job, then set NOT NULL. Backfill estimated ~20M rows. Need DB-owner + eng-infra review + runbook signoff. PTAL? :eyes:

Taylor: ack — can you paste the migration/backfill plan here (steps + rollback)?

Alex: sure, pasted minimal plan below:
```
-- 1) ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD COLUMN email_verified boolean;
-- 2) CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_user_profiles_email_verified ON user_profiles(email_verified);
-- 3) run background backfill worker that updates in batches of 5k, writing progress to job_progress table;
-- 4) monitor ops_grafana 'backfill/throughput' and 'db_replica_lag';
-- 5) after backfill completes, ALTER TABLE ... SET NOT NULL;
-- rollback: stop backfill worker, rely on NULL semantics until resolved
```
Also added a `--batch-size` flag so we can throttle.

Chris: quick thought — can we split into two PRs? schema+index now, backfill separately. merges less risky.

Alex: yep, I can split. Initially had them together to keep diff small but splitting makes sense.

Morgan: +1 to split. For backfill: add a kill-switch (job can be disabled via feature flag), and emit per-batch error rate and p95 update latency. If replica lag > 500ms, pause.

Jess: I can run a small canary next week on prod-standby. Ping me when backfill PR is ready.

Lee: also check bloat on replicas — concurrent index can still bloat if we run backfill while index builds.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please ensure migration runbook link is added to PR description and tag #eng-oncall for scheduling maintenance windows.

Alex: updated PRs — split into two: 492 (schema+index) and 493 (backfill job). Added runbook here: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/backfill-user-profiles. Tagged @Taylor @Morgan for review. I added `--max-errors=1000` and `--cpu-limit=0.5` to the worker.

Taylor: reviewed schema/index PR — LGTM, minor nit in migration comment. Approving.

Morgan: I'll take the backfill PR tomorrow morning; want to see metrics and a small dry-run on prod-standby.

Chris: approved schema/index as well, merge after CI green. Backfill held for Morgan + runbook verification. :white_check_mark:

Alex: thanks all — merging schema/index once CI finishes. Will wait to schedule backfill until Morgan confirms canary. Will post final schedule here. :rocket:
